decision.explanation: Document d2 explicitly states that 'Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is, in fact, an integral part of Anglicare Sydney,' and further supports this with details on shared governance and ACNC registration. While d1 mentions 'Anglican Retirement Villages' as the operator of a facility under its own name, this does not establish a broader 'part of' relationship beyond itself. Therefore, only 'Anglicare Sydney' is directly supported as the correct parent entity in the requested relation.
